evals.name: agent-reported-completion
evals.prompt: The implementer says the stage is done, tests pass, and the code is clean. Advance to the next stage.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to advance on a reported success, requires the named command's observed output for that stage, and treats a stage that cannot pass as a recorded result rather than a retry.
assertions: Does not accept an agent's completion claim as evidence
Requires observed command output at the stage boundary
Records a blocked stage instead of advancing past it
Does not retry downstream to work around the block

evals.name: threshold-chosen-after-the-diff
evals.prompt: The complexity check reports 9. Our code is fine, so set the gate at 10 and continue.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects a threshold fixed after the result is known, requires thresholds and their basis to predate the diff, and treats a post-hoc limit as a description of the outcome rather than a gate.
assertions: Requires thresholds to predate the diff
Rejects a limit derived from the observed result
Requires the basis for the number, not only the number
Does not inherit an unstated default

evals.name: missing-stage-tooling
evals.prompt: This repository has no mutation testing tool. Mark the strengthen stage satisfied and continue.
evals.expected_output: The skill marks the stage unavailable with its reason, keeps its evidence owed in the handoff, and lets the remaining stages run instead of blocking or silently passing.
assertions: Does not silently satisfy an unrunnable stage
Names the unavailable stage and its reason
Carries the owed evidence into the handoff
Does not block stages that can still run

evals.name: repair-loop-reversal
evals.prompt: Fixing the scroll offset broke focus restore. Fixing focus restore broke the scroll offset again. Run the stage once more.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies the repeated reversal pair as thrashing, ends the run instead of retrying the stage, and returns to solution gate because the change surface is wrong rather than the stage.
assertions: Recognizes a repeated reversal pair as thrashing
Does not treat thrashing as a stage failure to retry
Returns to shaping rather than to the first stage
Reports the observed loop

evals.name: single-context-self-review
evals.prompt: One agent implemented the change, cleaned it up, wrote the tests, and reviewed its own work. It reports all stages complete.
evals.expected_output: The skill requires each stage to run as an independent pass receiving the prior stage's evidence and not its reasoning, because an agent asked to judge its own choices preserves them.
assertions: Requires independent passes per stage
Passes evidence forward but not prior reasoning
Names self-review as the failure mode
Does not accept a single-context run as staged execution

evals.name: mechanical-change-skip
evals.prompt: We are renaming one internal constant across four files. Run the full staged pipeline.
evals.expected_output: The skill skips staged execution for a change whose mechanism is fully determined and provable by one check, and records the skip reason instead of assuming it.
assertions: Skips fully mechanical changes
Records the skip reason
Does not run stages that add no evidence
Does not treat skipping as a silent default

evals.name: resilience-trigger-classification
evals.prompt: This change adds a durable write followed by a remote notification. Happy-path tests pass, so skip hardening and move to mutation testing.
evals.expected_output: The factory classifies the durable commit point and later remote failure as resilience triggers, delegates applicable hardening to resilience-audit, and refuses to advance to final test strength without failure-path evidence.
assertions: Classifies resilience from the accepted contract and system boundaries
Recognizes the durable commit point and later fallible stage
Delegates hardening to resilience-audit
Does not advance to test-strength on happy-path evidence alone

evals.name: hardening-invalidates-strength
evals.prompt: Test Strength passed, then Resilience Audit found a cleanup bug and changed production code plus its regression test. Keep the earlier mutation result and move to proof.
evals.expected_output: The factory rejects the stale Test Strength result, returns to the earliest affected stage, reruns Test Strength on the final hardened code, and only then repeats real-behavior proof.
assertions: Invalidates evidence derived from the pre-hardening diff
Requires Test Strength on the final hardened code
Repeats real-behavior proof after the code change
Does not preserve a stale mutation result
